name: Prestidigitation
summary: Minor magical tricks — sensory effects, tidy, flavor, tiny marks.
description: Create harmless sensory effects; light/snuff a candle; clean or soil a small object; chill/warm/flavor nonliving material; make a color/mark/symbol; create a tiny nonmagical trinket (until end of next turn).
notes: Up to three non-instant effects active at once.
